Build stronger teams with sessions anyone can confidently lead

Ready-to-run, interactive team sessions help managers build trust, alignment, and collaboration, without heavy prep or lift from HR.

Request demo
Traditional team building is too time-intensive and too hard to scale

HR teams are buried
and can’t lead sessions for every team

Scheduling is hard
‍for half of full day workshops

Offsite impact fades fast
‍once teams return to real work

Paid facilitators are $$$
‍and can’t scale to every team

Managers need support
to facilitate workshops on their own

Generic activities don’t land
‍and miss real team issues

Introducing modern team development that actually scales

Rising Team Kits combine research-backed content and step-by-step guidance—everything managers need to run powerful, interactive team sessions

What’s included:
Ground rules + topic intro to set context & build trust
Warm-ups to spark engagement & conversation
Interactive activities to practice key behaviors
Reflections to turn discussion into action
Session survey to measure connection & impact

Building team insights through these sessions makes Arti smarter—so coaching and roleplay get more personalized over time.

Deeply human team development—built for the age of AI

Rising Team Kits give managers high-impact, research-backed sessions that strengthen trust, alignment, and team performance, without extra prep or support.

Manager-friendly by design

Step-by-step guidance through warm-ups, activities, and reflections—just like a professional facilitator

Targets gaps from pulse surveys

Sessions address the themes revealed in pulse and engagement surveys—tailored to each team’s context

Works for every kind of team

Desk-based or frontline, in-person or virtual—office, Zoom, or break room

Built on the drivers of high-performing teams

Psychological safety, feedback, appreciation, resilience, motivators, and more

Flexible by default

Run sessions in 10 minutes to 2 hours—in meetings, huddles, offsites (mobile-ready)

Consistent, org-wide delivery

Roll out team development across every team—without relying on external facilitators

Every manager can run a great team session
Discover the right session for your team

Based on each manager’s growth plan, preferences, and team context, Arti recommends the Kit that fits what the team needs now.

Lead a great session with confidence

Gather the team (in-person or on Zoom), hit start, and follow step-by-step prompts, activities, and reflections—like a professional facilitator.

Save team insights and turn them into action

Arti captures key takeaways and commitments as the team goes—so nothing gets lost—and turns them into clear next steps that carry into day-to-day work and future sessions.

Measure what’s improving over time

A quick post-session pulse tracks connection and effectiveness, helping leaders see what’s improving across sessions and teams.

Henri’ Dawes
VP Learning & Development
“In my 30+ years of organizational development and instruction design, Rising Team is the best product I've ever seen.”
Kits for all types of team structures, goals, lengths, and group sizes
Development Kits

Build the core skills and habits of high-performing teams—feedback, working styles, team norms, expectations, resilience, and more.

60-120 minutes
Connection Kits

Deepen trust and psychological safety through guided conversations that help teammates understand each other—and work better together.

60-120 minutes
Minis

Short, focused sessions that fit into regular team meetings—ideal for frontline teams and fast-moving schedules.

10-20 minutes
Leadership Transformation Kits

Create kits aligned to your leadership model and priorities, built for cascading frameworks and supporting transformation initiatives.

Download kit catalog
